Indicator: Major ICT incidents in the quarter
Definition (what it measures): Incidents classified as major under the incident policy
Calculation: Count of incidents with severity = major, closed or open, in the quarter

Definition (what it measures): Recovery tests where tested recovery time exceeded the Board's tolerance
Calculation: Count of tests in the period with tested time > tolerance
Data quality checks: Test reports attached; times checked by second line
Known limitations: Vendor-run tests reported by the vendor

Indicator: Critical Operations reliant on one provider
Definition (what it measures): Share of Critical Operations whose delivery depends on a single provider with no tested alternative
Calculation: Critical Operations with single provider / all Critical Operations
Source system: Register of third-party arrangements; Critical Operations map
Known limitations: No data quality check agreed yet

Indicator: Critical Operations tested in the last 12 months
Definition (what it measures): Share of Critical Operations with a recovery test in the last 12 months
Calculation: Tested Critical Operations / all Critical Operations

Definition (what it measures): Share of key controls rated effective in second-line testing
Calculation: Effective key controls / key controls tested
Data quality checks: Test files sampled by internal audit

Definition (what it measures): Findings rated high or critical, past their remediation deadline, on assets supporting Critical Operations
Calculation: Count of open findings with severity >= high and today > deadline, on in-scope assets
Data quality checks: Asset scope reconciled with inventory; approved exceptions excluded
Known limitations: Deadline counted from patch approval date (agreed definition)

Definition (what it measures): Share of required CBUAE notifications sent within the deadline
Board members who completed the annual resilience briefing
Calculation: Count of Board members trained this year

Indicator: Actively exploited vulnerabilities open over 7 days
Definition (what it measures): Vulnerabilities known to be actively exploited, open for more than 7 days on any asset
Calculation: Count of open findings flagged as actively exploited with age > 7 days
Source system: Vulnerability scanner plus threat intelligence feed
Data quality checks: Exploited flag checked against threat intelligence

Indicator: Median hours to contain a critical security alert
Definition (what it measures): Median time from a critical alert to containment
Calculation: Median of (containment time - alert time) for critical alerts in the period
Known limitations: Part of monitoring run by the group SOC
